create_distance_function: create a distance function using create() with a distance type string and options object
create_general_dist_function: create a generalized distance function with configurable alpha and scale parameters via create_general_dist
use_l1_distance: use the l1 distance type from DIST_MAP to compute absolute value scaled by distance_scale
use_l2_distance: use the l2 distance type from DIST_MAP to compute squared distance scaled by distance_scale
list_distance_names: list all available distance type names using DIST_NAMES to inspect supported distance functions
